method.basis: Immutable manifest, frozen candidate and observation ledgers, canonical records, and manifest-pinned local source pages only.
method.cross_product_rule: No plural route-by-treatment incidence was inferred.
method.forecast_rule: Prospective schedules do not establish delivered operation.

findings.assessment: The source forecasts full LIRR service to Grand Central Madison, but it does not enumerate exact branch-by-service-pattern applications.

evidence_gaps: Delivered operation is not confirmed by this pre-change evidence.
Exact LIRR branch and service-pattern incidence is not enumerated.
prohibited_inferences: Do not cross-product the LIRR network or rush-hour terminal split into branch applications.

prohibited_inferences: Do not treat administrative cost controls as a transit intervention application.

findings.assessment: The timetable plan groups multiple projects and construction activities without proving exact route-by-treatment incidence or delivered operation.

prohibited_inferences: Do not cross-product listed projects, branches, and timetable effects.
Do not infer delivery from a plan.

Canonical exact route and replacement-service treatment identities are absent.
